shared_elements: shallow-relief schematic motifs carved on a rounded upright stone face
stacked/registered arrangement of separate motifs down the surface
possible stylized face or mask-like element near the top
justification: Both show low-relief, outline-only schematic signs — curvilinear hooks, loops and angular scrolls — distributed as discrete motifs stacked vertically down the convex face of an upright block, and both hint at a mask/face element near the top, which is a moderately specific shared convention. The biggest difference in depicted content is that A is clearly an anthropomorphic figure with head, headdress, arms and a prominent chest disc within a banded torso, whereas B shows only free-standing abstract hooked and looped signs with no discernible body, disc or figural framework.
